newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices weaker at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices weaker at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were weaker at the weekly auction in Mombasa, auction officials said on Monday.
Brighter BP1s shed 6-13 U.S. cents while mediums dropped by up to eight cents. Brighter PF1s shed 4-14 cents while Brighter PDUSTs were dearer. Brighter DUST1s eased by 5-15 cents.
Most descriptions in the secondary catalogue were firm.
among buyers, Pakistan blenders were dominant while Egypt was less forceful. Somalia was active while Britain showed improved interest. --Wambui Chege, Nairobi Newsroom ++254-2 330-261.
